agents.name: Dataset Curator
agents.task: Curate 25-30 photos, crop to 1024x576, write captions with trigger word, package for upload
constraints: Read-only on research files. Write only to dataset/ directory.

agents.name: Cloud Environment Setup
agents.task: Set up RunPod A100 80GB template with Kohya_ss, ComfyUI, Wan 2.2 nodes, post-processing tools. Document model weight storage strategy.
constraints: Read-only. Document setup steps only — do not rent GPUs.

agents.name: ComfyUI Workflow Designer
agents.task: Design ComfyUI workflow JSON for Wan 2.2 I2V with camera control (TTM or Fun Camera Control), ControlNet stacking, and post-processing nodes. Pin ComfyUI version. Validate against /object_info endpoint.
constraints: Read-only. Design workflows only — do not execute.

agents.name: Flux LoRA Trainer
agents.task: Train Flux.1-dev DreamBooth LoRA on curated dataset using Kohya_ss. Validate identity with ArcFace cosine similarity (>0.7 = good). Save pytorch_lora_weights.safetensors.
constraints: Use inference-time lora_scale, NOT fuse_lora(). Expect 2-3 iterations.

agents.name: Wan 2.2 Video LoRA Trainer
agents.task: Train Wan 2.2 I2V dual-expert LoRA using musubi-tuner or finetrainers. Train two LoRAs: high-noise (composition/motion) + low-noise (texture/identity). Optional: three-stage training (high/mid/low noise). Save both .safetensors.
constraints: Optional — only if Track B selected. Requires video clips dataset.

agents.name: Cinematic Reference Image Generator
agents.task: Generate 3-5 cinematic reference images per target scene (10 scenes = 30-50 images) using Flux + LoRA + Five Pillars prompt framework. Output at 1024x576 (16:9) to match Wan 2.2 input. Use lora_scale 0.8-1.2 at inference (NOT fuse_lora). Save all images with metadata.
constraints: Depends on Wave 2 flux_lora. Generate at Wan 2.2 aspect ratio.

agents.name: Video Clip Generator
agents.task: Generate 5s 720P/24fps cinematic video clips from reference images using Wan 2.2 I2V in ComfyUI. Apply camera control (TTM or Fun Camera Control). Use anchor-frame workflow: last frame of clip N = first frame of clip N+1. Consider LightX2V 4-step LoRA for speed. Save raw clips.
constraints: Depends on Wave 3. Camera control at 640x640 on 24GB VRAM (not 720P).

agents.name: Post-Processing Pipeline Setup
agents.task: Set up GFPGAN → Real-ESRGAN → RIFE chain as ComfyUI nodes and standalone scripts. Prepare FaceFusion 3.6 as backup. Document exact commands and VRAM requirements.
constraints: Can run in parallel with video_gen. Set up only — do not process clips yet.

agents.name: Video Post-Processor
agents.task: Run GFPGAN → Real-ESRGAN → RIFE chain on all raw clips. Apply FaceFusion backup if identity drift detected. Output final 1080p+ 48fps clips.
constraints: Depends on Wave 4. ~10-20 min per clip on RTX 4090.

agents.name: Final Assembly Editor
agents.task: Assemble processed clips in DaVinci Resolve 21. Add audio (ElevenLabs for TTS, Suno/Udio for music, Freesound for SFX). Color grade with Shot Match + cinematic LUTs. Export 4K master + vertical social cuts.
constraints: Depends on postproc. Manual editing in DaVinci Resolve.
